name: Calcium fixture hotfix

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  patch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Apply fixture fix
        run: |
          python3 <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re

          script = Path("script.js")

          fix = r"""

          /* CALCIUM SPORT FIX 7075 */

          async function hydrateFixturesFromSheet(data){
            const sheetId =
              data?.selectedCompetition?.["Sheet ID"] ||
              data?.selectedCompetition?.SheetID ||
              "";

            if(!sheetId) return;

            try{
              const table = await loadGoogleVisualizationTable(sheetId, "Fixtures");

              if(!table || !table.rows || !table.rows.length) return;

              const headers = table.cols.map(c =>
                String(c.label || c.id || "")
                  .toLowerCase()
                  .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,"")
              );

              const find = (...names)=>{
                for(const n of names){
                  const i = headers.indexOf(
                    n.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,"")
                  );
                  if(i>=0) return i;
                }
                return -1;
              };

              const homeCol=find("Home");
              const awayCol=find("Away");
              const scoreCol=find("S","Score");
              const dateCol=find("Date");
              const timeCol=find("Time");

              if(homeCol<0 || awayCol<0) return;

              const read=(row,i)=>{
                if(i<0) return "";
                const c=row.c[i];
                return c && (c.f ?? c.v) || "";
              };

              data.matches = table.rows.map((row,index)=>{

                const home=read(row,homeCol);
                const away=read(row,awayCol);

                if(!home || !away) return null;

                const score=read(row,scoreCol);

                let homeScore="";
                let awayScore="";

                const match=String(score)
                  .match(/(\d+)\s*-\s*(\d+)/);

                if(match){
                  homeScore=match[1];
                  awayScore=match[2];
                }

                return {
                  ID:`${home}-${away}-${index}`,
                  MatchID:`${home}-${away}-${index}`,
                  HomeTeam:home,
                  AwayTeam:away,
                  HomeScore:homeScore,
                  AwayScore:awayScore,
                  Score:score,
                  Date:read(row,dateCol),
                  Time:read(row,timeCol),
                  Status:
                    homeScore!=="" && awayScore!=="" 
                    ? "FT"
                    : "Scheduled"
                };

              }).filter(Boolean);

            }catch(e){
              console.log(e);
            }
          }

          """

          text = script.read_text()

          if "CALCIUM SPORT FIX 7075" not in text:
              script.write_text(text + "\n" + fix)

          index = Path("index.html")
          html=index.read_text()

          html=re.sub(
              r"script\.js\?v=\d+",
              "script.js?v=7075",
              html
          )

          index.write_text(html)

          PY

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions"
          git config user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Apply Calcium fixture fix 7075" || exit 0
          git push
